items.headline: Oracle falls as planned $20 billion debt and share sale highlights concerns about debt-funded AI infrastructure spending
items.summary: Reuters reported that Oracle dropped almost 9% after regulatory filings showed plans to raise $20 billion through debt and equity, intensifying investor scrutiny of financing for cloud infrastructure expansion.

items.headline: Marvell declines after announcing acquisition of Lumentum
items.summary: AP reported that Marvell fell 12.7% after announcing it would acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction involving 4.5 Marvell shares for each Lumentum share.

items.headline: Lumentum drops after Marvell acquisition announcement despite earnings beat
items.summary: AP reported that Lumentum shares fell 18.6% after Marvell announced the acquisition; Lumentum supplies lasers and other products used in AI and cloud infrastructure networks.

items.headline: Apple dips ahead of quarterly report as investors focus on AI spending and memory costs
items.summary: Reuters reported that Apple shares declined before its quarterly report while investors remained focused on elevated AI infrastructure spending, technology-sector volatility and rising memory-chip costs.

items.headline: AI-stock selloff weighs on broader market as investors question returns on infrastructure spending
items.summary: The Atlantic reported that the five largest AI-data-center companies were on track to spend about $900 billion on AI in 2026, while the scale of investment was contributing to investor anxiety and a recent market decline.

items.headline: AI hardware earnings become a key test for investor confidence
items.summary: An Investing.com earnings outlook identified AMD, Super Micro, Arista Networks, Skyworks and Astera Labs as major Tuesday AI-hardware reports that could indicate whether data-center spending is still accelerating.
